products.name: Ultrahuman Ring AIR / Ring PRO
products.description: 连续采集睡眠、恢复、运动、心率、心率变异性、皮肤温度、女性健康与代谢等生理信号的智能戒指；Ring PRO采用新架构并支持最长15天续航。
products.target_customers: 关注睡眠、恢复、代谢与整体健康的消费者

evidence_refs.quote: Ring AIR weighs about 2.4 grams and offers roughly 4–6 days of battery life, according to Ultrahuman. The company also introduced Ring PRO in 2026, with a redesigned architecture and up to 15 days of battery life.
Ring PRO moves more computation onto the wearable itself through a new sensing architecture, on-chip machine learning and expanded on-device storage.

products.name: Jade AI
products.description: 实时生物智能AI平台，整合Ring数据、Blood Vision及其他健康输入，将健康信息变得可对话、有情境且可行动。
features: 将复杂生理信号转化为个性化洞察

evidence_refs.quote: Jade, Ultrahuman’s real-time biointelligence system, brings those signals together to make health information conversational, contextual and actionable.

Jade AI reflects the company’s vision of transforming complex physiological signals into personalized insights and health recommendations, making health data more accessible and useful for everyday users.

products.name: Blood Vision
products.description: 分析超过100项生物标志物的血液检测服务，覆盖心血管、代谢、激素与炎症健康领域，可与可穿戴数据结合提供更丰富的健康图景。
products.target_customers: 希望获得更深层生化健康洞察的用户
features: 覆盖心血管、代谢、激素、炎症

evidence_refs.quote: Its Blood Vision service analyzes more than 100 biomarkers covering areas such as cardiovascular, metabolic, hormonal and inflammatory health.
Blood Vision brings biochemical information across cardiovascular, metabolic, hormonal, inflammatory and longevity markers.

analysis.capital_judgment: 本轮资本押注的核心变量是Ultrahuman能否把智能戒指这一硬件入口，扩展为连接连续生理信号、血液生物标志物、医疗记录与AI解读的健康智能平台，并进一步成为人体作为计算界面的载体。已验证信号包括：FY2025运营收入从FY2024的1200万美元增至6400万美元并实现820万美元净利润；Ring AIR已建立智能戒指市场地位，Ring PRO将更多计算移至设备端；Jade AI与Blood Vision构成软件与数据层；与Stanford合作分析227,860晚数据、排卵确认准确率90%+等临床与科研进展。证据边界在于：本轮70百万美元融资的具体轮次名称、领投方与估值均由媒体或第三方披露，官方新闻稿未明确轮次与领投方；$365百万美元估值来自TechCrunch报道而非公司官方确认；健康智能平台的商业化规模、临床验证深度与用户信任度仍需持续验证。
